source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 25.6, printed page 241.

blocks.text: Pakistan ka jughrafiya shimal (north) ki sab se oonchi chotiyon se le kar junoob (south) mein Arabian Sea tak phaila hua hai. Is se ecological diversity (mukhtalif qism ke mahol aur jandaron) ki ek "chhoti si duniya" (miniature world) ban jati hai. Neeche Pakistan ke chaar sab se ahem ecosystems bayan kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein Pakistan ke kaun se chaar ecosystems bayan kiye gaye hain?
blocks.explanation: Temperate Deciduous Forest, Tropical Thorn Forest, Alpine aur Sub-Alpine Meadows, aur Mangrove Forest.

items: Pakistan: shimal ki oonchi chotiyon se junoob mein Arabian Sea tak; chaar ahem ecosystems: temperate deciduous forest, tropical thorn forest, alpine meadows, mangrove forest.
